name: sh.aadhar/site
title: Aadharsh Site
description: Search, photos, music, coffee availability, Lens and image tools for aadhar.sh. Keyless.

serverInfo.name: aadhar.sh
serverInfo.title: Aadharsh Site
serverInfo.description: Bounded public utilities for aadhar.sh: search, music, photos, coffee availability, Change Radar, Lens, ephemeral image inspection/transforms, exact published-photo recipe matching, an HTTP representation vault, and the site's published page resources.

tools.name: ask
tools.title: Ask
tools.description: Ask aadhar.sh a natural-language question and get NLWeb-shaped results: for each match a url, name, site, score (0-100), description, and a schema.org schema_object. Retrieval is lexical over the site's own corpus and descriptions are extractive, so this returns the passages that answer the question rather than a written answer. mode=summarize and mode=generate are refused by name: this origin runs no language model.

site.description: NLWeb site token; this origin serves one site, so "aadhar.sh" or "all"

mode.description: list (the only one served here); summarize and generate are refused rather than degraded

prev.description: previous queries. Received and NOT resolved, since decontextualization needs a model; send decontextualized_query instead

decontextualized_query.description: the fully self-contained form of a follow-up question. When present this is what gets searched

top_k.description: Maximum results. `limit` is read when top_k is absent.

score.description: 0-100. With Clef ranking, the probability Clef puts on this page.

schema_object.description: A schema.org node for the result.

ranking.description: Which ranker ran: Clef, or lexical with the reason.

outputSchema.description: NLWeb /ask answer, returned as one JSON body when streaming=0.

tools.name: search_site
tools.title: Search Site
tools.description: Search the public pages, writing, garage notes, and utility descriptions on aadhar.sh by keyword. Returns ranked hits, each with a url, title, kind and snippet. Use it to find a page on this site; use ask when you want NLWeb's result shape with a schema.org object per hit.

limit.description: Maximum results. Values outside the range are clamped, and a non-number falls back to the default.

tools.name: now_playing
tools.title: Now Playing
tools.description: Read what Aadharsh is listening to right now: the current rn playlist's id and name and its tracks, each with title, artists, duration and Spotify link. A cold cache may refresh from the public Spotify embed using AadharshBot.

song_link_url.description: A song.link forwarder to the listener's own music service.

error.description: Present, with an empty tracks list, when no playlist is set.

tools.name: photo_query
tools.title: Photo Query
tools.description: Search the photo archive. `q` is free text scored per term across caption, EXIF and an offline term expansion, so "classic chrome bridge" matches film and subject; camera, lens, film, recipe and from/to are exact filters. Results carry `score`, `matched` (fields that answered) and a `recipe` card of in-camera settings. `ranking.mode` is all-terms, partial or no-match; `ranking.dropped` and `ranking.common` name ignored terms. GPS and unlisted EXIF are never returned.

q.description: free-text query, ranked; multiple words are scored independently

film.description: film simulation name, e.g. "Classic Chrome", "Nostalgic Neg", "Acros"

recipe.description: substring match anywhere in the recipe card, e.g. "DR400", "Clarity: -2", "Grain Effect: Strong, Large", "+2 Red"

limit.description: Page size. Values outside the range are clamped, and a non-number falls back to the default.

query.description: The normalized filters, empty strings when absent.

dropped.description: Terms dropped as matching nothing; omitted when empty.

common.description: Terms dropped as too common; omitted when empty.

ev.description: Exposure compensation: a number, or a signed string such as +0.33.

date.description: As EXIF writes it, YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS, with no timezone.

recipe.description: The frame's film recipe card, keyed the way a recipe is written down. Absent on frames with no recipe.

metadata.description: Public-safe EXIF and Fuji fields, read from the file. A field the camera did not record is null and a field the extractor never read is absent: nothing is guessed.

matched.description: Terms that matched, when q was given.

tools.name: coffee_availability
tools.title: Coffee Availability
tools.description: Read the open coffee-chat slots with Aadharsh, in the host timezone, plus the booking URL. Use it before suggesting a time to meet. If the calendar is stale or unavailable, the result is explicitly unavailable and contains no slots.

tools.name: change_radar
tools.title: Change Radar
tools.description: Read what changed recently across the sites AadharshBot crawls daily (the VC neighborhood on /around): per target, which of status, final URL, title, description, content type, robots and content moved, when, and how severe. Raw crawled bodies are not stored or returned.

limit.description: Maximum change records. Values outside the range are clamped, and a non-number falls back to the default.

detail.description: content only, which carries no before or after.

tools.name: lens_inspect
tools.title: Lens Inspect
tools.description: Inspect one public HTTP(S) URL through Lens, origin-level discovery included, and return a compact agent-readiness summary: status, title, word count, readiness score and level, agent doors counted, and the machine surfaces found. Use it to judge how well agents can read a site. Private, local, and non-HTTP targets are rejected.

url.description: A public http or https URL, https:// if no scheme is given. Ports other than 80 and 443, credentials, and private or link-local hosts are refused.

tier.description: unknown or a spectrum tier when measured; null when discovery did not run.

wallCheck.description: ok, none, no AI binding, or the error the wall check hit.

phases.description: Which passes ran. A field from a pass that did not run is absent, never zero.

surfaces.description: Null when discovery did not run.

tools.name: lens_page
tools.title: Lens Page
tools.description: Read one public URL and return only what derives from the page's own bytes: anatomy, structured data, a markdown rendering, and what it costs an agent to ingest. Skips the origin-level fan-out entirely, so it is far cheaper and far faster than lens_inspect. Readiness, agent doors and terms are ABSENT from the result (not zero) because they were not checked; `phases.discovery` is false. Use lens_inspect when you need those.

url.description: A public http or https URL, https:// if no scheme is given. Ports other than 80 and 443, credentials, and private or link-local hosts are refused.

tier.description: unknown or a spectrum tier when measured; null when discovery did not run.

wallCheck.description: ok, none, no AI binding, or the error the wall check hit.

phases.description: Which passes ran. A field from a pass that did not run is absent, never zero.

surfaces.description: Null when discovery did not run.

tools.name: lens_compare
tools.title: Lens Compare
tools.description: Inspect two public HTTP(S) URLs side by side. Returns a Lens summary for each (left and right) plus the list of fields that differ across status, content, readiness, spectrum, agent doors and discovery surfaces. Use it to see why one page or site reads better to agents than another.

tier.description: unknown or a spectrum tier when measured; null when discovery did not run.

wallCheck.description: ok, none, no AI binding, or the error the wall check hit.

phases.description: Which passes ran. A field from a pass that did not run is absent, never zero.

surfaces.description: Null when discovery did not run.

tier.description: unknown or a spectrum tier when measured; null when discovery did not run.

wallCheck.description: ok, none, no AI binding, or the error the wall check hit.

phases.description: Which passes ran. A field from a pass that did not run is absent, never zero.

surfaces.description: Null when discovery did not run.

tools.name: find_events
tools.title: Find Events
tools.description: Search the Serendipity event pool (community events worth going to, and who's RSVP'd) by keyword. Returns events the pool's contributors actually said yes to; pass rsvp:"all" to include events that were only browsed.

q.description: optional keyword filter on event name, place, or contributor

rsvp.description: defaults to going (the events with real rosters)

topic.description: optional: only events classified as this topic; unclassified events are counted in `untagged`

format.description: optional: only events classified as this format (talks, meal, social, ...)

limit.description: maximum events to return; defaults to 50

when.description: The time window searched: upcoming, past or all.

rsvp.description: The RSVP tier returned: going, all or discovered.

total.description: Events in the window that match every filter, before limit.

start_at.description: ISO 8601 start time, or null when the pool has none.

url.description: The event's Luma page.

attending.description: True when a contributor RSVP'd yes or hosts it.

rsvp.description: The contributor's RSVP status, or unknown.

contributors.description: Pool contributors who saw the event, comma separated.

tags.description: The stored topic and format with their confidences, or null when the event is unclassified.

events.description: The matching events, soonest first for upcoming and latest first for past.

discovered_hidden.description: With rsvp=going, how many matching events were left out because nobody RSVP'd.

topic.description: The topic filter applied, when one was.

format.description: The format filter applied, when one was.

untagged.description: With a topic or format filter, events in the window that are not classified yet.

tools.name: image_inspect
tools.title: Image Inspect
tools.description: Inspect an image's format, dimensions, byte size and whether it is animated, from bytes you send or a public URL. Returns a receipt with the input's size and SHA-256 and what Cloudflare Images read. Use it before image_transform to see what you have. Image bytes are processed ephemerally and are not stored.

image_data.description: base64 image bytes, optionally as a data URL, up to 8 MiB. Takes precedence over source_url.

mime_type.description: image MIME type of image_data, such as image/png; read from the data URL when omitted

source_url.description: public HTTP(S) image URL to fetch when image_data is not given, up to 8 MiB

url.description: The final URL after redirects, for source_url; null for image_data.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the input bytes.

output.description: The single encoded output, for image_transform; null otherwise.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the output bytes, the same bytes as the image content block.

info.description: What the Images binding read from the input.

tools.name: image_transform
tools.title: Image Transform
tools.description: Resize, re-encode or rotate one image through Cloudflare Images, from a preset or explicit width, height, fit, format and quality. Returns the transformed image inline plus a receipt of exact input and output bytes and hashes. Use it to make a web-ready copy. The output is ephemeral.

image_data.description: base64 image bytes, optionally as a data URL, up to 8 MiB. Takes precedence over source_url.

mime_type.description: image MIME type of image_data, such as image/png; read from the data URL when omitted

source_url.description: public HTTP(S) image URL to fetch when image_data is not given, up to 8 MiB

preset.description: explicit fields override it: web 1600w AVIF q82, thumbnail 600x600 cover AVIF q84, universal 1600w JPEG q84, og 1200x630 cover JPEG q82

fit.description: how the image fills width x height, with Cloudflare Images' fit semantics

format.description: output format; defaults to the preset's, else avif

quality.description: encoder quality; defaults to the preset's, else 84

url.description: The final URL after redirects, for source_url; null for image_data.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the input bytes.

output.description: The single encoded output, for image_transform; null otherwise.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the output bytes, the same bytes as the image content block.

info.description: What the Images binding read from the input.

transform.description: The resize options sent to Images; a key is absent when neither the call nor the preset set it.

tools.name: image_compare
tools.title: Image Compare
tools.description: Encode one image into up to three format variants (AVIF, WebP, JPEG) at the same size and quality, and return each variant inline plus a receipt of exact byte sizes, hashes and the smallest format. Use it to pick a delivery format by bytes. It does not score visual quality.

image_data.description: base64 image bytes, optionally as a data URL, up to 8 MiB. Takes precedence over source_url.

mime_type.description: image MIME type of image_data, such as image/png; read from the data URL when omitted

source_url.description: public HTTP(S) image URL to fetch when image_data is not given, up to 8 MiB

formats.description: output formats to encode, one variant each; defaults to all three

preset.description: sets size, fit, and quality; each variant keeps its format: web 1600w q82, thumbnail 600x600 cover q84, universal 1600w q84, og 1200x630 cover q82

width.description: output width in pixels, applied to every variant

height.description: output height in pixels, applied to every variant

fit.description: how the image fills width x height, with Cloudflare Images' fit semantics

quality.description: encoder quality for every variant; defaults to the preset's, else 84

url.description: The final URL after redirects, for source_url; null for image_data.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the input bytes.

output.description: The single encoded output, for image_transform; null otherwise.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the output bytes, the same bytes as the image content block.

info.description: What the Images binding read from the input.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the variant, the same bytes as its image content block.

variants.description: One entry per encoded format, in request order.

recommendation.description: The format of the smallest variant.

note.description: What the comparison does not measure.

tools.name: photo_recipe
tools.title: Photo Recipe
tools.description: Return the exact public EXIF and Fuji recipe for a named archive photo, an archive URL, or the exact bytes of a published thumbnail. Use it to learn how a photo on aadhar.sh was shot. Returns matched false with a reason for anything else, since visual lookalikes are not treated as matches.

stem.description: published photo stem, the archive's id for a photo, as photo_query returns it

source_url.description: an aadhar.sh archive URL: /images/full/<file>, /i/<stem>.<hash>.avif or .jpg, or /i/<stem>-400.<hash>.avif

image_data.description: base64 bytes from a published thumbnail

matched.description: True when the input named a published photo exactly.

inputSha256.description: On a miss by bytes, the SHA-256 that matched nothing.

reason.description: On a miss, why nothing was returned.

input.description: The SHA-256 of image_data on a byte match; null otherwise.

matchKind.description: How it matched: stem, archive-url or published-thumbnail.

matchedTier.description: The thumbnail tier that matched (a AVIF, j JPEG, s small), or null.

full.description: Site path of the full-size original.

ev.description: Exposure compensation: a number, or a signed string such as +0.33.

date.description: As EXIF writes it, YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS, with no timezone.

recipe.description: The frame's film recipe card, keyed the way a recipe is written down. Absent on frames with no recipe.

metadata.description: Public-safe EXIF and Fuji fields, read from the file. A field the camera did not record is null and a field the extractor never read is absent: nothing is guessed.

tools.name: representation_capture
tools.title: Representation Capture
tools.description: Capture bounded public HTTP representations under browser, bot, Markdown, or identity request profiles and store only normalized headers, metadata, and body digests. Writes: each call persists a new snapshot row, so this tool is not read-only and not idempotent.

url.description: public HTTP(S) URL to capture

profiles.description: request profiles to capture, one snapshot each; defaults to browser, markdown, and identity

url.description: The URL fetched.

persistence.description: What the vault keeps: normalized headers, metadata, and body digests only.

id.description: The snapshot id, for representation_read and representation_compare.

url.description: The URL requested.

profile.description: The request profile used: browser, bot, markdown or identity.

bodyBytes.description: Body bytes read, up to the cap.

bodyHash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the body bytes read.

truncated.description: True when the body passed the read cap.

title.description: The HTML title, for an HTML body.

wordCount.description: Words in a text body; null for a binary one.

url.description: The URL requested.

anyOf.description: A profile that failed; nothing was stored for it.

snapshots.description: One entry per profile, in order.

tools.name: representation_read
tools.title: Representation Read
tools.description: Read one stored HTTP representation snapshot from the vault by id, as representation_capture or representation_compare returned it. Returns its status, normalized headers, body size and digest, title and word count. Raw response bodies are never returned because they are never stored.

id.description: The snapshot id, for representation_read and representation_compare.

url.description: The URL requested.

profile.description: The request profile used: browser, bot, markdown or identity.

bodyBytes.description: Body bytes read, up to the cap.

bodyHash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the body bytes read.

truncated.description: True when the body passed the read cap.

title.description: The HTML title, for an HTML body.

wordCount.description: Words in a text body; null for a binary one.

persistence.description: What the vault keeps: normalized headers, metadata, and body digests only.

tools.title: Representation Compare

url.description: optional replacement URL, otherwise the snapshot URL

profile.description: The stored snapshot's profile, reused for the refetch.

tools.name: finger
tools.title: Finger
tools.description: Look up who runs aadhar.sh, as a drivable terminal program. Panes: overview, writing, reading, listening, photos, around, coffee, deploys, search. Send `keys` to move (1-9 pane, j/k cursor, <cr> open, h back, ? help) and pass the returned `url`'s params back to continue. Returns a rendered 80-column frame.

keys.description: a key sequence, up to 32 keys, e.g. "2jj<cr>"

pane.description: Pane to show before applying keys

cursor.description: Zero-based row to select before applying keys

open.description: id of the row to open (slug, index, or version number)

frame.description: Rendered 80-column terminal frame as plain text

url.description: Site-relative path and query string for reopening the terminal view

tools.name: photos
tools.title: Photos
tools.description: Browse the published photo archive as a terminal frame, filterable by caption, film simulation, body, and lens. Opening a frame shows its exposure and the in-camera recipe it was shot with. Send `keys` (j/k cursor, <cr> open, n/p page).

keys.description: Key sequence, such as j<cr> to move down and open a photo

q.description: Text to find in the archive

film.description: Filter by Fuji film simulation, such as Classic Chrome

cursor.description: Zero-based row to select before applying keys

frame.description: Rendered 80-column terminal frame as plain text

url.description: Site-relative path and query string for reopening the terminal view

tools.name: radar
tools.title: Radar
tools.description: Render signal readings you have already measured (wifi/Bluetooth RSSI) as a terminal instrument: concentric strength bands, a meter and trend per source, and findphone's field calibration (-45 arm's reach, -60 same table, -72 same room). This origin has no antenna and does not sense anything; you supply the samples. Nothing is stored. Angles in the plot are decorative because RSSI carries no bearing.

samples.description: signal readings you measured, one per source

kind.description: optional tag, e.g. wifi or ble

history.description: optional trailing readings for the trend

source.description: optional label for what did the sampling

frame.description: Rendered 80-column terminal frame as plain text

sources.description: Number of signal samples accepted for rendering

tools.name: encode
tools.title: Encode
tools.description: Read a JPEG or AVIF at a URL and report what its encoder actually did: chroma subsampling, baseline vs progressive and the scan count, an estimated quality with the deviation from the IJG Annex K table shown, AVIF bit depth, and whether ICC/EXIF/XMP is riding along. NO PIXELS ARE DECODED — every fact comes from the container — so this works on files a Worker could never decode.

url.description: public URL of a JPEG or AVIF to read; omit it for the intro frame

frame.description: Rendered 80-column terminal frame as plain text

url.description: Site-relative path and query string for reopening the terminal view

tools.name: agent_ready
tools.title: Agent Ready
tools.description: Grade how much of an origin a machine can actually use: llms.txt, a markdown twin, an agent card, an API catalog, and a real tools/list against its MCP server. Doors are COUNTED, never scored — a check that could not run is reported as unreadable rather than as a failure. Called with no url it audits aadhar.sh itself and prints what building that cost in files and lines.

url.description: origin or page URL to grade; omit it to audit aadhar.sh

frame.description: Rendered 80-column terminal frame as plain text

url.description: Site-relative path and query string for reopening the terminal view

tools.name: dict
tools.title: Dict
tools.description: Will a browser ever actually use the compression dictionary a URL is serving? Compression dictionaries fail in total silence — Chromium declines to register a perfectly good one because of a cache directive, with no warning anywhere. Returns a rendered frame grading every registration rule, plus whether a delta-serving response varies on available-dictionary. Same route as /dict.

url.description: URL serving the compression dictionary to grade; omit it for the intro frame

frame.description: Rendered 80-column terminal frame as plain text

url.description: Site-relative path and query string for reopening the terminal view

tools.name: cache
tools.title: Cache
tools.description: Does a URL's ETag ever actually 304? A BEHAVIORAL probe rather than a header read: fetches twice to see whether the validator survives two identical requests, then replays it with If-None-Match and reports what the origin did. Also checks Accept negotiation against Vary. Returns a rendered frame. Same route as /cache.

url.description: public URL to probe for ETag and 304 behavior; omit it for the intro frame

frame.description: Rendered 80-column terminal frame as plain text

url.description: Site-relative path and query string for reopening the terminal view

tools.name: lens
tools.title: Lens
tools.description: Inspect one public HTTP(S) URL and render the observation as a terminal frame: readability, agent doors, and what a single scan costs to read. Same rate limit and same refusals as lens_inspect; use lens_inspect instead if you want the fields rather than the frame.

url.description: public HTTP(S) URL to inspect

doors.description: also READ behind the agent doors: llms.txt, the markdown twin, the agent card, and a real tools/list on their MCP server (listed, never called)

frame.description: Rendered 80-column terminal frame as plain text

url.description: Site-relative path and query string for reopening the terminal view
